title: On monodromy and spectral geometry of generalized Lamé equations with four singularities, I: half periods
summary: We consider the unitary monodromy problem of the following generalized Lamé equations with apparent parameters \begin{equation*} y^{\prime\prime}(z)=\left(\frac{3}{4}\sum_{k=0}^3\wp(z-\frac{ω_k}{2};τ)+\sum_{k=0}^3T_kζ(z-\frac{ω_k}{2};τ)+B\right)y(z), \end{equation*} where $T_0,\cdots, T_3, B$ are apparent parameters. We first decompose the space of apparent parameters, which turns out to be an algebraic set, into three irreducible components.
